name: advanced-stats
title: Advanced Stats Section
blurb: InView-triggered sequence animation with blur and vertical offset.
description: Generic timeline animation component using Framer Motion. Triggers on InView with staggered animations (blur+offset), custom variants support. Renders as configurable element type.
use_when: Animating multiple items sequentially as they enter viewport, like stats or feature lists.
avoid_when: When you need simultaneous animations or continuous motion.
a11y: Blur animation in motion may affect readability; consider prefers-reduced-motion. Content remains accessible.
